pending_commit.commit_message: network_WiFi_APSupportedRates: improve DUT-transmission filters {Broad,multi}cast frames may get re-transmitted back at the DUT, using its own SA (but not TA). These are not under the DUT's control and should not penalize the DUT, if they happen to be at a lower rate. Similarly, some Ack or BlockAck frames are getting transmitted at lower rates, but that only appears to be because the frame to which the DUT is replying (i.e., the AP's frames) are transmitted at those rates. Also avoid penalizing the DUT for simply Ack'ing at the same rate. We probably could fix these sorts of problems within the AP, but that's less important to us than getting the DUT behavior correct. BUG=none TEST=run it Change-Id: I27d1cbf8ebdf13a0e55c29cead6b42df1c7bacb0 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1679995 Tested-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Neeraj Poojary <npoojary@chromium.org>

pd_faft: Set DUT TrySrc setting on every detach/attach iteration The DUT TrySrc setting is updated when the battery charge state changes, i.e. the HOOK_BATTERY_SOC_CHANGE. When running multiple detach/attach iterations, the power role changes, as DRP role results as either a sink or a source. This power role change causes the battery charge state changes, and makes the TrySrc setting changes, that we don't expect. This CL sets the desired TrySrc setting on every iteration. BUG=b:131840808 TEST=Ran firmware_PDTrySrc and checked the ratio around 50% when TrySrc off. The result without this CL was close to one end as the TrySrc setting was changed on implicitly. Change-Id: Iaa23056904dc6a72822d82dad6d8aa752d0c08b5 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1686533 Tested-by: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com> Commit-Ready: Wai-Hong Tam <waihong@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Jett Rink <jettrink@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dana Goyette <dgoyette@chromium.org>

timing: Fix a panic bug on unmarshaling incomplete logs. Formerly timing.Log type contained "now" member to allow overriding time.Now calls in unit tests. In production it is almost always set to time.Now, but actually UnmarshalJSON left it nil, so importing an incomplete log caused a panic by nil function calls. This change removed "now" member from the struct but instead introduces "now" global variable whose default value is time.Now. UPSTREAM: Input: document meanings of KEY_SCREEN and KEY_ZOOM It is hard to say what KEY_SCREEN and KEY_ZOOM mean, but historically DVB folks have used them to indicate switch to full screen mode. Later, they converged on using KEY_ZOOM to switch into full screen mode and KEY)SCREEN to control aspect ratio (see Documentation/media/uapi/rc/rc-tables.rst). Let's commit to these uses, and define: - KEY_FULL_SCREEN (and make KEY_ZOOM its alias) - KEY_ASPECT_RATIO (and make KEY_SCREEN its alias) Signed-off-by: Dmitry Torokhov <dmitry.torokhov@gmail.com> BUG=b:135045276 TEST=Build (cherry picked from commit 07ba9e7be423423043c5090a2f395c0da26e1b3d) Signed-off-by: Dmitry Torokhov <dtor@chromium.org> Change-Id: I8863dd12d794c1cd3ea52fe131975d735a45750c Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromiumos/third_party/kernel/+/1689755 Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Benson Leung <bleung@google.com> (cherry picked from commit d281074b6ccca0a6f8477a784c28a12a3503363e) Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1690112 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org>
